en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, and Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, altogether from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from Abu Hamza Al Sumaly who said,
‘I heard Abu Ja’farasws saying: ‘Rasool-Allahsaww said: ‘The one who pleases a Momin so he has pleased measws, and the one who pleases mesaww, so he has pleased Allahazwj’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa all from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from abu Hamza al-Thumali who has said the following: “
I heard abu Ja’far (a.s.) saying, ‘The messenger of Allah has said, “Whoever pleases a believer has pleased me, and whoever, pleases me has pleased Allah.’”
